forward.description: List of domain-to-upstream-server mappings. Each entry defines a domain and its upstream DNS servers, optionally with a policy and search domain behavior. The policy field supports 'first' and 'all'. The search field (bool) controls whether search domains should be applied when forwarding (default: false). Each server can be a hostname or IP (optionally with port, e.g., '127.0.0.1:53').
